title: Sports City International
description: sportscity.com.tw sportscityvn.com Sports City International, SCI, is a Taiwanese sportswear manufacturer founded in 1988 in Taipei, headquartered in Neihu Science Park, and one of the top three garment makers for global athletic brands. Its clients include Nike, adidas, Under Armour, lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, REI and Gymshark, producing performance apparel, jackets, jerseys, yoga wear and down outerwear. From four people in a small office it has grown to over 35000 employees across 14 factories in Vietnam, the Philippines, Cambodia and China, with capital of NT165 million. Its Vietnam SNP plant is the group's first fully automated smart factory using IoT and real-time data, and Nike USA headquarters visited it in 2026 to review end to end automation. SCI is a hidden champion in World Cup and Olympics teamwear supply chains and even created the first NFT plus physical hoodie. It runs strong ESG programs, SBTi carbon targets, a 2040 carbon neutral blueprint.
